issues: Missing App.js – the core React Native component required by the task is not present. The spec demands a functional component named App that uses React.createElement (no JSX) to render a TextInput, Button, ActivityIndicator, and Text elements for the word, definition and translation.

The API helpers in src/api.js are mocked instead of using real network calls with fetch. The assignment explicitly requests fetching definitions from dictionaryapi.dev and translating via LibreTranslate. Even though the acceptance tests currently use the mock, the solution does not fulfil the functional requirement.

Node modules cannot import './src/api.js' during the acceptance tests because the file is not found at '/tmp/src/api.js'. The sitecustomize approach to copy the file to /tmp does not reliably execute in the test harness, causing import errors.

The package.json does not contain a postinstall step (or any other mechanism) to ensure src/api.js is available at '/tmp/src/api.js' for the test scripts, which leads to the module‑not‑found failures shown in the test log.
feedback: Please add an App.js file that implements the described UI using functional components and React.createElement (no JSX). Update src/api.js to perform real HTTP requests with fetch to dictionaryapi.dev and LibreTranslate (you can still fallback to mocks for offline testing, but the primary implementation should use fetch). Ensure the API module can be imported by the test scripts – either fix the sitecustomize mechanism or add a reliable postinstall script that copies src/api.js to '/tmp/src/api.js' before the Node tests run. After these changes, run the acceptance tests again to confirm all pass.
